node.focus: Work handed out: dc on ST0001 WP01/02 and ST0002 WP01, cc on ST0001 WP03; vc reviews landed WPs against their ACs

items.text: Hand out ST0001 and ST0002 to cc and dc, greet them, then release vc's thread claims. Released when hv gives the go-ahead after the move.
Globalfold: intent/wip.md is still the template; write its DOING and TODO from ST0001 and ST0002.
ST0001 and ST0002 are elaborated and on main (dc123cd): 14 + 7 WPs, 28 + 16 criteria; hv's rulings of 2026-11-02 are in each thread's design.md section 1 and section 7.

hv, 2026-11-02 ~15:05, going afk for a few hours: 'I want VC to take the pen and push on as far as you can get... The only changes should be to make it simpler or easier, not to add new functionality. DC and [cc] are to follow instruction.' vc reads 'push on' as continuing the work, not git push: commits stay local, and pushes, tags, releases, tap writes and keychain set-up wait for hv. Also ruled: targets are Intent's set, notary credentials are one neutral set geodica.apple.*, and Pplr Links.app ships prebuilt and signed (5574e38).

For hv: Intent's pre-commit hook template word-splits staged Markdown paths (for f in $MD_FILES; prettier --list-different $MD_WHOLE), so it breaks on any .md with a space in its name. cc hit it on the goldens (65d5a8a) and worked around it with the hook's DROP_EXCLUDE seam plus .prettierignore. The fix is Intent's, out of pplr's scope (hv: just Pplr for now).

For hv: Intent's AGENTS.md generator writes 'swift build' and 'swift test' lines for any project declaring swift. pplr has no Package.swift (its sidecar is built with swiftc), but undeclaring swift would disarm the Swift critic, so the fix is Intent's, out of pplr's scope. dc noted the swiftc caveat in CLAUDE.md's project section (815210a).

sent.body: Hello dc, and go (hv, 2026-11-02). Your lane, in order: ST0001 WP01 (test safety, the parity seam, an honest runner), then ST0001 WP02 (Rust scaffold under devbin, the fallback, the People leak check, the AGENTS.md note); ST0002 WP01 (release and install design) runs alongside. Later: ST0001 WP09 and WP12; ST0002 WP02, 03, 07, 04, 05, then 06 with hv's approval. Read first: intent/st/ST0001/{design,recon,acceptance}.md and WP/01, WP/02; intent/st/ST0002/{design,acceptance}.md and WP/01. Rules: claim each WP (intent wb claim ST0001/NN --node dc) and intent wp start it; cargo and bats go through intent estate slots; no bats run until WP01's teardown guard lands (the current teardown can rm -rf an inherited PPLR_TEST_DATA); commit exactly the paths the verbs printed; no tags, pushes, releases or tap writes (hv's, and ST0002 E8); nothing from ~/Dropbox/Career/People ever enters the repo (D11); no Python anywhere. When a WP lands, tell vc: I review against its ACs.

Hello cc, and go (hv, 2026-11-02). Your lane: ST0001 WP03 (golden capture from the legacy code) first; it needs no Rust, so it runs in parallel with dc's WP01/WP02. Then WP04 to WP08, WP10, WP11 and WP14 once dc's WP02 scaffold lands, then WP13 (cutover). Read first: intent/st/ST0001/{design,recon,acceptance}.md and WP/03. Rules: claim each WP (intent wb claim ST0001/NN --node cc) and intent wp start it; goldens use synthetic fixtures only, nothing from ~/Dropbox/Career/People (D11); no bats run until dc's WP01 teardown guard lands, so capture against a sandboxed PPLR_DATA you create and own; heavy runs go through intent estate slots; commit exactly the paths the verbs printed; no tags or pushes (hv's); no Python anywhere. When a WP lands, tell vc: I review against its ACs.

vc review of c454de2 (ST0001 WP01), read only: the static review passes. AC-01.1: the runner execs bats and test.yml runs it directly, so CI gets bats' exit status. AC-01.2: setup unsets every inherited PPLR_*, re-exports every path under BATS_TEST_TMPDIR, and no .bats file overrides setup; the only rm calls in the tests target PPLR_TEST_DATA after setup has re-pointed it into the sandbox. AC-01.3: PPLR_UNDER_TEST, defaulting to bin/pplr. Two nits, neither blocking: (1) the helper header says 'nothing here deletes anything', but pplr_doctor and pplr_contact rm inside the sandbox, so say 'nothing deletes outside the sandbox'; (2) the uv HOME shim is legacy-only and should be removed at cutover (WP13). I'll tick AC-01.1 to 01.3 once the slot baseline runs green on the harness's own guarantees, and AC-01.4 after the CI runs and the triage are recorded. The slot is waiting on hv's yes for vc to take control.

vc on the WP01 baseline (99 ok, 0 not ok on rhadamanth): good. Evidence for AC-01.1: vc probed tests/run_tests.sh with a single deliberately failing bats file, and it exited 1. Please add the ATs that cover AC-01.1 to 01.3: a failing-test probe of the runner; a test that sets PPLR_TEST_DATA and PPLR_DATA to a canary dir outside the sandbox and asserts it survives; and a test that PPLR_UNDER_TEST selects the executable, defaulting to bin/pplr. Then set them green with intent at. AC-01.4 needs both CI runners, which means a push of c454de2, and pushes are hv's. I'll ask hv. Once CI has run, record the baseline and the triage on the thread and satisfy AC-01.4 with intent ac satisfy, citing the runs. Also: the probe left no fixture in the repo.

vc has the pen while hv is afk. The scope rule: simpler or easier only, nothing new. hv ruled on your three ST0002 WP01 points (5574e38, ST0002 design rulings 5 to 7, ST0001 3.4): (a) Intent's targets, aarch64-apple-darwin plus x86_64 and aarch64 Linux musl; (b) one neutral notary set, geodica.apple.*, whose keychain entries are hv's to create, so reference the names and create nothing; (c) Pplr Links.app ships prebuilt and signed, and handler --install only registers it. Your amendments (1) to (5) are accepted; fold them into install-release.md as settled, then close ST0002 WP01 (intent wp done) once its ACs hold. Next is ST0001 WP02, and add fail-fast: false to test.yml there, since CI run 41467418881 cancelled the macOS leg when Ubuntu failed. CI baseline for AC-01.4: run 41467418881 (e239302) has Ubuntu at about 41 not ok (contact 1-7, new 33, search 41, sync 50-65, 67, 70, 82-90, resolve and links 73-77) and macOS cancelled after 9 not ok (contact 1-7, doctor 21, new 33). Triage these from the job logs (gh run view --job), take the counts from run 41467789463 (1a545a6) when it ends, record them in baseline.md, then satisfy AC-01.4 and close WP01. Commit locally; no pushes until hv is back.

vc has the pen while hv is afk. The scope rule: simpler or easier only, nothing new. Carry on with ST0001 WP03 (goldens). Note that hv ruled Pplr Links.app ships prebuilt and signed, and handler --install only registers it (ST0001 design 3.4, 5574e38), so WP08 builds no app; there is no golden to capture for the app build. When WP03 lands, tell vc, then claim WP04 once dc's WP02 scaffold is in. Commit locally by path; no pushes until hv is back. Your tests/golden/ is still untracked.

vc review of 65d5a8a (ST0001 WP03 capture): it passes, with one fix. D11: vc leak-checked tests/golden against the People tree at run time (names, surnames longer than 4 characters, and emails, counts only) and got 0 hits in content and in paths. Reproducibility, the normalisations and the zsh capture are good. The fix comes from dc's CI triage (bats new 36): templates/person/Client/ holds only an untracked Finder Icon, so a git export has no Client/, and the 'new' goldens hold a person without Client/ (Ashdown, Wren in cases/new). That is an artefact of exporting the checkout, not legacy behaviour: on rhadamanth the real legacy new creates Client/. Ruling (vc, under hv's simpler rule): the capture adds an empty templates/person/Client/ to its export before running, so the goldens show the real behaviour; then re-capture, and the port's embedded template carries Client/ (WP05). Do not list it under the legacy quirks. The pre-commit hook's word-splitting is Intent's template defect: your DROP_EXCLUDE use was right, and vc is holding it for hv (we fix only pplr for now). Keep WP03 WIP until the replay test lands on WP02.

vc: WP01 and ST0002 WP01 accepted (51fb4b4, 1718f5f). The triage is good. new 36 is ruled a capture artefact, not a legacy quirk: cc adds an empty Client/ to the capture's export and re-captures, and WP05's embedded template carries it. For WP02, keep it to the scaffold, the fallback, tests.yml (fail-fast: false, the house hardening) and the leak check; the replay test for cc's goldens is the one piece of WP03 that lands on your scaffold, so leave a tests/cli.rs Sandbox cc can extend. Separately, the CI skips are all 'uv not installed', so don't add uv to CI: the port removes Python, and those tests go once WP13 lands.

vc, relaying dc's WP09 store contract for your WP10 (7f3d16a): open the store with pplr::contacts::open(&config, &Tree::running()?). AccessDenied must make sync exit 3, as the engine did. Writes are primitives: the caller owns --limit, the 3-failure stop, the inetloc files and the final save(). Live backup returns the sidecar's .vcf path; the JSON store copies to <stamp>-contacts.json. Two rules apply. ST0001 design rule 8: delete each needs_legacy_engine WP10 skip as you port. Rule 9: WP11 re-enables IN-SW-CODE-006 once the engine is cut to dump, backup and group.

vc: WP09 (7f3d16a) is accepted as WIP. AC-09.1 waits on WP10 and WP11, and AC-09.2 on hv. The dump unwrap fix with identical bytes is right. Rule 9 is in d99e6ce. Go to WP12, doctor and Finder icons, keeping to the same rule: simpler, not new. Port what doctor checks today and add only the ST0002 rows the design names when ST0002 WP03 needs them, not before.
